storyline.real: Mansell pits on lap 61 with tyre trouble, rejoins sixth, recovers to second behind Senna and clinches the title with five races left
storyline.headline: Mansell clinches his crown with a win

mastery.label: Make exactly one stop, as Mansell did

hidden.label: Do better than Mansell's real second place

eras.briefing: Hungaroring, 1992. Mansell leads the championship on 86 points; Patrese is second on 40. A good result here can make Mansell champion with five races to spare. Pit board only. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps and the sourced stops (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). The lap-by-lap gaps and running order are synthetic, not history.
